title: councilkit review finding
description: One finding in review.submitted data.findings. Contest key = anchor|category, so neither may contain |. id is unique only within one reviewer. disputes lists contest keys (anchor|category) or other reviewers' findings as reviewer/id that this finding disagrees with; a bare id is accepted only when exactly one other reviewer has a finding with that id. lib/findings.mjs validateFinding is authoritative.
